answer: Skein can learn from both and compare their local desktop output. Prefer adapting converter contracts, structured extraction and provenance before considering runtime adoption. Neither Python stack is a demonstrated Android replacement.

performed: Read pinned primary source, licenses and dependency declarations
Inspect current Skein import and citation source
Hash downloaded source bytes and verify local source against the baseline commit
not_performed: Dependency installation or upstream code execution
Model download, license clearance or conversion benchmark
Owner-document access, Android build, CI, or device operation
Retrieval tuning or changes to gold labels and thresholds
scope.source_boundary: Facts below describe the pinned repository files; transitive dependencies, individual model revisions and runtime behavior have not been audited.

markitdown.statement: Code is MIT. The package declares Python >=3.10,<3.15; base dependencies include requests, BeautifulSoup, markdownify and Magika. PDF support adds pdfminer.six >=20251230 and pdfplumber >=0.11.9.

DocumentConverter accepts a binary stream plus StreamInfo; accepts must restore the stream position. DocumentConverterResult exposes Markdown and an optional title, without page/block/span provenance. StreamInfo describes format, name, local path and URL.

Built-in converters default on and plugins default off. General convert dispatch supports paths, URLs, response objects and streams; explicit convert_local or convert_stream narrows that I/O surface. Non-seekable streams are fully buffered.

The PDF converter buffers the source, uses pdfplumber word coordinates for form/table heuristics and pdfminer for text extraction, and returns Markdown. Page cache release does not remove the whole-source buffer. This converter has no OCR path.
DOCX conversion uses Mammoth with HTML conversion; XLSX conversion uses pandas/openpyxl and renders worksheet content. These are separate optional format dependencies, not Android implementations.

marker.statement: Current repository code is Apache-2.0. The separate MODEL_LICENSE has distinct conditions; the code license alone does not establish permission for model use or output distribution.

MODEL_LICENSE Attachment A 2(a) and 2(b) restrict use above prior-year revenue of $5 million or total equity/debt funding of $5 million, with personal/research exceptions in those clauses. Clause 2(c) separately restricts competing products/services without that exception. Section 8 applies share-alike language to outputs and their derivatives. These are review flags, not a conclusion about Skein legal eligibility.

Package marker-pdf 2.0.0 declares Python >=3.10,<4, PyTorch >=2.7,<3, Transformers >=5.12.1,<6, Surya OCR >=0.22.1,<0.23 and pdftext >=0.7,<0.8. Optional cloud API SDK dependencies do not prove a conversion uses the cloud.

The current model factory creates clients for shared Surya servers: balanced VLM layout/recognition, fast layout, and OCR-error classification. Digital table reconstruction uses text-layer heuristics; scanned tables use page OCR. The README describes vLLM Docker on NVIDIA and llama-server on CPU/Apple Silicon. This is a host/server architecture, not an Android integration demonstrated here.

Optional use_llm defaults false; the default configured repair service is GoogleGeminiService when that option is enabled. This optional LLM processing is separate from Surya VLM OCR. Fast mode with disable_ocr can avoid VLM OCR, but still uses other models and is not a model-free arm.

JSON output contains document metadata and page/block children with id, block_type, html, polygon, bbox, optional children/section_hierarchy/images. Block IDs encode page and block position/type. The internal block schema also tracks extraction method and source, but JSONRenderer does not explicitly emit those internal fields per block.
Markdown rendering supports page delimiters and table serialization. Neither page-delimited Markdown nor layout IDs are immutable original-file hashes or Skein revision anchors.

skein_today.statement: PdfImporter uses PDFBox Android on a whole input buffer, appends text page by page with separators and returns only nullable text/title. Empty extraction and caught parser/password failures have no typed distinction; OCR is absent.

ImportServiceImpl reads the full PDF, first saves its original bytes as an attachment, then creates a new source-linked note from extraction or a no-text-layer notice. The source frontmatter links the attachment ID. This code does not provide a page/block mapping or establish one transaction across attachment and note creation.

Current citation records use document ID, revision hash, locator and excerpt. Revision hashing addresses canonical body/frontmatter; retrieval locators identify byte ranges in that body, not coordinates in an original PDF. Offered items without revision/locator are omitted from the persisted anchored record.
Production lexical evidence coverage remains lexical-query-coverage-v1 with default minimum 0.5. Converter evaluation does not change this policy.

inferences_and_adaptation.inference: A small Android-native extraction interface is the first useful adaptation: explicit supported format, bounded input, cancellation, typed outcome and page-level output. MarkItDown provides a useful separation of dispatch from converters; directly shipping its Python dependency graph is not justified by this inspection.

Marker is the stronger structure/OCR comparison candidate; its structured output may preserve table/page relationships that plain Markdown loses. Quality, speed, resource fit and model terms remain gates. Use local desktop evaluation before any Android port decision.

Current PdfImporter appends separators before checking whether the combined body is blank. A multi-page document with empty extracted page text may therefore yield separator-only nonblank text. Include a two-page scan/blank fixture; this is a source-derived risk, not an executed reproduction.

Preserve original attachment bytes, extraction output and any optional repaired output separately. A cleaner table or fluent repaired sentence is a candidate extraction, not a verified fact and not proof that a citation supports an answer.

proposed_provenance_mapping.status: proposal_only; no locked schema or runtime change
rules: Page/block IDs and polygons locate layout; they do not establish stable source identity across reruns or file revisions.
Original byte SHA256 and Skein canonical revision hash have different domains; preserve both and map spans after normalization.
Do not infer extraction method from a missing Marker JSON field; instrument an explicit adapter or record unknown.

Keep scanned/no text, encrypted, malformed, unsupported, resource failure, cancellation and partial extraction distinguishable; preserve warnings instead of silently converting every failure into no text.
Validate every span and excerpt against the exact revision. Valid anchors establish identity and integrity, not factual support.

next_bounded_benchmark.status: proposed; corpus/golds/thresholds have not yet been created or frozen
next_bounded_benchmark.first_deliverable: Create only synthetic source documents and independently authored gold records, then seal their hashes plus split and metric definitions before running converters. Add a host adapter contract that retains all failures and outputs without executing model downloads.

corpus.size: 12 parseable PDFs, exactly 24 pages, plus 2 failure inputs (one password-protected PDF and one deliberately truncated PDF); 14 inputs total
pairs: Two single-column PDFs with headings, links, footnotes and exact numeric facts
Two multi-column PDFs with explicitly authored reading order
Two table PDFs with merged headers, units and cross-page continuation
Two raster scan PDFs including rotation and a page without machine text
Two mixed-script/equation PDFs with unambiguous gold transcriptions
Two blank/mixed-empty PDFs, including one with two wholly blank pages
corpus.split: One document from each pair is development and the other held-out validation: 6 PDFs/12 pages per split. Failure inputs are an integrity suite. Author and seal validation gold before conversion; do not tune after exposing it.
corpus.gold: Fixture authors record source-page text/order, table cells and header associations, supported numeric/entity facts, absent-fact probes and source locators. Freeze source PDFs, gold JSON, generator version, fonts and metric configuration by hash. Converter output and converter agreement are never gold.
corpus.scope_limit: PDF only first. DOCX/XLSX and real owner documents require a separate authorized scope.

candidate_arms: Current Skein PDFBox extraction at a pinned source revision, through its existing controlled test harness in a later serialized verification slot
Pinned MarkItDown local PDF conversion; explicit local file/stream, plugins disabled, no remote converter or URL input
Pinned Marker fast mode with disable_ocr, only after reviewing every actual model license/artifact and host resource requirements
Optional later Marker local OCR arm with exact fast/balanced/backend/model configuration after the same unresolved model and resource gates; use_llm stays false for this comparison
metrics: Per-page text coverage and reading-order error; character/word error against independent transcription for scanned pages
Table cell exact values, row/column and header association, numeric value/unit preservation, page attribution
Supported-fact extraction recall and introduced/unsupported-fact rate, reported separately from any downstream answer metric
Source-hash coverage, page/block mapping coverage, UTF-8 span validity, exact excerpt resolution and cross-document anchor errors
Typed outcome/warning accuracy for blank, encrypted, malformed, partial and unavailable conversion; include every input in denominators

Wall time, peak host RAM, model/artifact disk bytes and output bytes; later authorized runs record one cold and three warm repetitions per arm/input, with descriptive ranges rather than unreliable small-sample p95 claims
next_bounded_benchmark.integrity_acceptance: Zero missing original hashes, invalid claimed anchors, cross-document anchors or silently dropped failures. Preserve raw outputs and actual warnings even when a quality gate fails.
next_bounded_benchmark.quality_acceptance: Pre-register numeric quality thresholds before running validation. No threshold or pass result is invented here; report each arm against independent gold and current reference behavior.
next_bounded_benchmark.retrieval_boundary: This is extraction evaluation. Keep existing retrieval gold, labels, split, thresholds and lexical-query-coverage-v1 at 0.5 unchanged; development-falsified alternatives remain disabled. A later retrieval experiment requires its own frozen protocol, including supported false rejection and unsupported acceptance.

open_gates: Applicability of exact model licenses, competitive-use and output obligations before model execution or distribution; no legal clearance claimed
Pinned transitive dependencies, model manifests, network behavior and artifact hashes for any executable harness
Measured extraction quality, table/fact fidelity and complete typed-failure handling
Host and eventual Android memory, latency, battery, thermal and cancellation behavior
Explicit source-to-revision provenance mapping and citation integrity tests
Independent benchmark gold and preregistered thresholds; no retrieval or production promotion from source review
